description: We are a great team consisting of 3 members: Viktoriia, Yura and Markiian, each learning software development. Two of us are pursuing Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, while the third is pursuing Bachelor’s degree in  Japanese Philology. Our main goal is to make life easier for both ordinary people and scientists.
summary:
Our project was inspired by the Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map challenge, part of the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It lets users explore both a global map of Mars and detailed 3D maps of selected locations. Access to these maps is important for astronauts and future Mars explorers. They can use the maps to review available data on the Martian surface, examine terrain features, and plan routes based on distance and terrain difficulty.
The project is written in Python and uses publicly available libraries, including MIT-licensed components. Super intelligence (SI) was used in several aspects of development.
details:
The project Survival Guide: Martian Map challenge is designed to help astronauts, scientists and others to explore Mars more safely. It allows users to investigate the planet and its terrain as well as plan safe routes between 2 points using the A* algorithm. It helps find a suitable path taking distance and surface slope into account, which is quite useful especially for astronauts. As for a common user, we wanted to make their exploration and understanding easier. Interactive maps make it possible to see the information directly on the surface.

Our project is written in Python, uses libraries such as NumPy, Plotly, Rasterio, Pillow, GeoPandas and Matplotlib, publicly available datasets about Mars (NASA and other sources). Also, super intelligence was used in some aspects of development such as information gathering, translation, writing and editing, coding and debugging, and others.

We combined different features in one project providing some useful tools (switching, zooming etc.) so everyone could explore Mars more comfortably.
projectRefs: The Global CTX Mosaic of Mars
